nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is Hakurei Reimu, exactly as in <Picture 1>: dark brown hair with the large red frilled bow, twin side-tails tied with white frilled ribbons, red eyes, red-and-white detached-sleeve shrine outfit with a yellow ascot and a red frilled skirt, a fan of paper ofuda in her LEFT hand and a wooden gohei with paper streamers in her RIGHT. Build is 7 heads tall, slim. She FLIES — she stands on nothing, sits on nothing, and almost never touches the ground; her default is floating upright with her feet loose and her weight nowhere. Her expression starts bored and stays bored well past the point where it should not be. Two yin-yang orbs, black-and-red spheres the size of her head, drift lazily at her back and only move fast when she does. She degrades across the clip: the right ribbon torn off and gone, one detached sleeve split along the seam, a scrape on her knee, dirt up one side, hair dragged out of shape. No blood — danmaku leaves her scuffed, not cut. She speaks Japanese. <Subject 2> is an unnamed youkai: a coiling centipede the length of the shrine grounds, plated in lacquered black segments, each segment carrying a lit paper lantern, with a flat white featureless face at the head and far too many small legs. It fills the sky above the shrine and fires dense lattices of purple danmaku from every lantern at once. It is far larger than her and never stops moving.

staging: The staging is AERIAL and VERTICAL. The whole fight happens in the air above the Hakurei Shrine at dusk, with the shrine roof, the torii, and the forest small and far below. The youkai coils around the upper frame; Reimu holds the lower air, small against it. The camera is usually below or level with her, looking up past her at the mass of the thing. Danmaku is drawn as flat bright discs and rings in clean layered patterns, not sparks. Reimu's motion is UNHURRIED — she slips through the gaps with the smallest possible movement, ankles crossed, one hand still holding her teacup, and she does not appear to be trying. That stops at 6.40s. After she is knocked down she is unsteady in every shot: floating crooked, one shoulder low, drifting when she means to hold still.

order (fixed): she floats and ignores it → it opens fire → she weaves through without standing up → A LANTERN BEAM CATCHES HER → she is driven down through the torii into the shrine grounds → she lies flat in the gravel → silent realisation on her face → she rises straight up and declares the spell card → she brings the yin-yang orb down and the seal opens → sealing orbs converge → the youkai is pinned and unwound → it bursts into light and drifts apart → she lands on the veranda and speaks.

dialogue: Japanese. Each line is spoken exactly once. At 10.10s, loud and formal, the way a spell card is announced — flat authority rather than emotion, the name snapped out in two halves: 「霊符（れいふ）——『夢想封印（むそうふういん）』！」 pronounced REI-FU, then MU-SOU-FUU-IN, 「れいふ」 clipped short, a beat of silence, then 「むそうふういん」 driven out hard and even with the last syllable held. At 18.70s, flat, dry, mildly put out, muttered to nobody in particular: 「……で、あんた誰だったのよ」 — pronounced DE, AN-TA DA-RE DAT-TA NO YO, dropped on the tail of an exhale with no energy behind it, 「のよ」 trailing away. Everything before 10.10s is wordless: bored breathing, one short annoyed click of the tongue, and a grunt when she lands.

shots:
0.00-2.30s - Static wide from below, looking up past the shrine roof into a red dusk sky. She floats cross-legged well above the tiles with her back to camera, gohei across her lap, holding a teacup, hair and streamers moving in the high wind. Behind and above her the youkai unwinds out of the cloud layer, segment after segment, lanterns lighting one by one down its length until it fills the whole upper frame. Motion from the first frame: the camera is already rising, and she is already drifting slowly sideways without noticing.
2.30-4.00s - Low angle three-quarter on the youkai's head as it swings down the lens axis toward her, blank white face filling the frame, every lantern flaring at once. She turns her head only — not her body — and looks up at it over her shoulder. One tongue click. The first lattice of purple discs launches.
4.00-6.40s - Wide side-on, both in frame, her tiny at the bottom. She threads the lattice without uncrossing her ankles: tilting, sliding, rotating around one shoulder, the tea in the cup never spilling. Her yin-yang orbs cut ahead of her and burst three lanterns in white flashes. Ofuda leave her hand in flat fans and detonate along the youkai's flank. HER FACE STAYS FLAT — half-lidded, unimpressed, mouth a straight line — while the frame around her is saturated with danmaku. The camera pans with her, whip-fast.
6.40-7.40s - Tight at her eye level, three-quarter. A lantern on a segment behind her opens directly into her back at point-blank. Her eyes widen for the first time. The teacup leaves her hand. She is driven forward and DOWN out of frame, gaze dragged up over her shoulder at the thing as she goes.
7.40-8.60s - Camera falls with her from above, the shrine grounds rushing up. She goes through the crossbeam of the torii, splintering it, and hits the gravel flat on her front, bouncing once and sliding out sprawled, arms loose, gohei clattering away, ofuda scattering white across the ground. The teacup lands upright beside her head, unbroken, and rocks. Far above, the youkai coils and turns for another pass.
8.60-9.70s - Tight on her face at gravel level, dust settling on her cheek, one eye opening. She pushes up on both palms and looks straight up the empty air at it. The realisation lands: eyes snap wide for one frame, mouth opens on a caught breath — the silent 'ah' — and then everything drains out of her face and it goes cold and blank. She reaches sideways without looking and her hand closes on the gohei.
9.70-11.30s - Full-body wide from below, shoulders squared, gaze fixed straight up. She rises off the ground standing perfectly upright, feet together, dead vertical, and keeps rising. A single ofuda between two fingers ignites, unfolds into a spell card that hangs burning in the air beside her, and she declares it: 「霊符——『夢想封印』！」 The card's name plate flashes across the frame. Both yin-yang orbs snap into orbit around her.
11.30-12.70s - Tight side-on on her hands, head bowed, looking down at the orb between her palms. She brings both hands together on the larger yin-yang orb overhead and drives it straight down through the air in front of her. Two-frame hit-stop, one white flash, and a huge circular seal — concentric rings of red script — opens flat in the sky beneath her and blows the dusk clouds outward in a ring. The recoil folds her forward. Her head stays bowed. A full beat of silence just before contact.
12.70-13.20s - Static wide, both in frame, the youkai's blank face turning down toward the light. Seven sealing orbs — red, blue, green, yellow, white — spawn out of the seal in three frames and hang motionless, strobing the frame. The camera is struck, not tracking. Her head stays down.
13.20-16.30s - Wide from the side, her back three-quarter to camera, watching upward. Her head lifts slowly, heavily, over most of a second. The orbs launch one after another in spiralling arcs, each one slamming into a different segment with a white bloom, pinning the body in the air. The lanterns burst down the whole length. The coil is dragged straight, unwound, and held stretched across the entire frame, thrashing, light pouring out of every joint.
16.30-18.20s - Wide side-on, she hangs in the air turned away from camera, watching it go. The seal above closes. The youkai comes apart from the head down into drifting motes of white light and folded paper, the lantern frames tumbling away and burning out before they reach the trees. The sky clears to plain dusk. Paper and light drift down past her.
18.20-20.00s - Camera steadies at her eye level as she sinks the last few metres and touches the shrine veranda with her toes for the first time in the clip. She is three-quarter to camera, gaze up at the empty sky, then dropping. Swaying, both hands on the gohei, shoulders heaving, drifting motes settling in her hair. She looks at the splintered torii, then at the scattered ofuda she will have to pick up, and mutters: 「……で、あんた誰だったのよ」 Then she gives up, sits down hard on the veranda edge, lets the gohei roll off onto the gravel, and flops backward flat on her back with both arms sprawled, eyes shut. The two yin-yang orbs drift down and settle on either side of her head. Light keeps falling.

style: Bright clean 2D anime cel animation matching <Picture 1> — crisp colored linework, saturated red-and-white against a deep dusk sky, bold flat shapes, the youkai in lacquered black with warm lantern orange. Danmaku rendered as clean flat discs and rings in layered geometric patterns, purple for the youkai and white-red for Reimu, always readable, never a particle haze. Blinding white strobe at the seal, warm low sun at the open, cool clear dusk at the close. Cutting accelerates toward the declaration; the 4.00-6.40s weave is the one sustained flowing beat, and the 11.30s downstroke is the one deliberate hold.

overall_soundscape: High wind, cicadas far below, ceramic tapping as she sets the cup against its saucer, a vast dry rustle of a hundred segments moving, lanterns igniting in a run, the flat percussive chatter of danmaku firing in waves, discs passing close, ofuda snapping and bursting, then a single heavy beam impact, wood splintering at the torii, gravel and a hard flat body impact, the cup landing and rocking, silence, her breathing, the spell card igniting with a paper snap, her 「霊符——『夢想封印』！」, the orb driven down, one beat of silence, a deep tolling chime as the seal opens, seven bright impacts in a rising sequence, lanterns bursting down the length, a long tearing dissolve, then only wind, paper settling, ragged breathing, 「……で、あんた誰だったのよ」, the gohei rolling off the veranda onto the gravel, and a soft heavy thud on wood.

non_diegetic_music: None.
